levelsNote: 0 = the old mine, the track and the Outfall's shaft; 4 = the lower sewers (the Junction's row and the Cistern); 8 = the upper sewers (the two north rows); 9 = the cells. A waterfall is a whole drop of 7 m from an upper culvert's mouth into a lower ROOM's water (mondo 11-16: "the waterfall should lead to a lower pathway or room"; then "the waterfalls still look short, at least twice that height"). District R (11-16): the Power Station Drain stands on level 4 and pours its sludge 7 m into the Sludge Pit on level 0; the Sludge Pit and the Outfall are one level and share a doorway (no opening row: two plots of one level simply share open squares on their line).
